calibration_population: Independent legal economic events with decision>=2018-01-01 AND actual/shadow exit<=2021-12-31; funded paths authoritative only
capital_days: Integral of native marked exposure in CNY calendar-days divided by original entry cash outlay; right censor not fitted
native_score: ATRDR source_rank_order; MCB industry_positive_ret20_share; GAP target_at_entry; SMV6 route prior (callback ordinal is not alpha)
buckets: At most five equal-count score quantiles fitted on discovery decisions only, no outcome optimized edges; constant/missing scores use route prior
risk_fallback: max(abs bucket CVaR10, abs parent route CVaR10, 0.05); bucket n<30 uses parent; parent n<30 native executable ceiling
native_reference: OGR authoritative physical account, pre-funding holdings at existing legal marks; proposed Native order contribution and existing same-security/family/account contributions plus proposed order

ranking_formula.R0: 0 equal priority, positive quality gate still applies

liquidity: Preserve SMV6 50% registered execution-window volume and 100-share lots; stocks maximum 1% strictly prior 20 completed-session mean raw daily amount where 20 valid denominators and raw units verified, otherwise Native executable notional ceiling. No daily future amount used for admission.
lineage: Gap exact gap_id merged to OGR parent with IFCGR flag; ATRDR Bull/MCB require source ignition identity plus matching signal/entry sessions, native three ranking quantities and native T15_H15 economic definition; otherwise retain separately. Primary ATRDR label when merged. Raw date+symbol alone never sufficient.
batching: Native exit callbacks and target reductions at same clock execute before joint exposure-increase allocation; all stock/GAP/SMV6 legal increases at that timestamp form one batch. Equal rank deterministic pro-rata subject to shared security/family/account constraints.
sizing: Opportunity budget determines desired new notional; source target-percent/slot amounts are context and conservative fallback, never a strategy sleeve ceiling. Existing holdings retained; only Native membership-change reductions/exits execute.
initialization: Exact authoritative 2018 inherited cash, positions and native state; no cash reset. Existing inherited positions may exceed a candidate cap, cannot be forcibly resized; cap allows no increases until headroom positive.
pareto: top5 event positive PnL concentration lower
distinctness: Unique rank/family architecture first; identical daily equity paths count as one; Pareto then Sharpe then CAGR; no additional grid dimensions
validation: Freeze before evaluating 2022-2023. PASS if CAGR>=Native and MaxDD<=Native OR CAGR>=0.8*Native positive CAGR and MaxDD<=0.8*Native and Sharpe>=Native; MARGINAL if positive CAGR with MaxDD<=Native but misses PASS; FAIL otherwise. Only PASS survives.
post_hoc_catastrophe: Any diagnostic year MaxDD>max(2*Native same-year MaxDD,0.15) OR negative full diagnostic cumulative return rejects shadow recommendation; never tune
